title: Lion cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#e8433f'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='17' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8a7a'/>
  <path d='M72 37 L69 41 L75 41 Z' fill='#b32a28'/>
  <path d='M72 41 Q68 52 64 62' stroke='#c9d6e8' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cub body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f2b23e'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#ffe3a8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='89' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e09b28'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='89' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e09b28'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='90' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe3a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='90' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe3a8'/>
  <!-- left arm reaching up to string -->
  <path d='M56 66 Q62 60 64 62' stroke='#e09b28' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='19' fill='#f2b23e'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <g fill='#d9761f'>
    <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='33' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='33' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='48' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='62' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='67' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='16' fill='#f8cb62'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#f2b23e'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#f2b23e'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#f7db99'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#f7db99'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffe9bc'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='32.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <path d='M35.5 52.5 L40.5 52.5 L38 55 Z' fill='#b06a2a'/>
  <path d='M38 55 Q36 58 33.5 56.5 M38 55 Q40 58 42.5 56.5' stroke='#b06a2a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='2' fill='#f79a8a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='2' fill='#f79a8a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M60 82 Q72 82 72 74' stroke='#e09b28' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#d9761f'/>
</svg>
